summary: Comprehensive frontend QA across 9 roles + public pages on preview URL https://airyatra-corporate.preview.emergentagent.com. All 9 credentials authenticate successfully (200 OK, JWT accepted). Public pages /,/services,/fleet,/about,/blog,/booking,/aircraft/browse all render (HTTP 200). Customer dashboard, Smart Booking (/customer/smart-booking with Instant Quote / My Auctions / Start Auction tabs), My Trips, Payments, Refunds, Auctions all load. Operator dashboard, /operator/asre, /operator/fleet, /operator/bookings load. Admin dashboard, /admin/users, /admin/operators, /admin/bookings load. HR, Sales, Finance, Employee dashboards load at their root paths. Logout button (data-testid*=logout) is present in Customer, Operator, Admin, Employee dashboards and correctly redirects to /login. Two CRITICAL post-login redirect bugs found for CEO and Pilot roles (see below). Production URL https://airyatra.co.in NOT tested — task only tested preview per REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL guidance.

ui_bugs.issue: CEO login → navigate(`/${role}`) sends user to /ceo, but NO route /ceo exists in App.js. User lands on 404 NotFoundPage (h1='404'). CEO Dashboard component exists at /app/frontend/src/components/admin/CEODashboard.js but is not wired to any Route. Repro: login as ceo@airyatra.co.in / CEO@123456 → URL becomes /ceo → 'Page Not Found / पेज नहीं मिला'.

Pilot login → navigate('/pilot') → 404. Actual pilot route is /pilot-portal (defined in App.js line 281). Redirect uses roles[0]='pilot' but no /pilot route registered. Repro: login as pilot@airyatra.co.in / Pilot@123 → /pilot → h1='404'.

Persistent red 'CRITICAL SECURITY ALERT — CRITICAL Risk Login Detected-hacker@test.com' banner displayed to every admin. Appears to be seeded/mock security event with no way to dismiss permanently. Confusing for real users. Should either be seeded only in dev or made dismissible with persistence.

issues: Since CEO/Pilot land here after successful login, it looks like a broken app rather than a routing bug. No indication user is logged in.

action_items: CRITICAL: Add Route path='/ceo' (or path='/ceo/*') element={<CEODashboard/>} in App.js so CEO login lands on the CEO Dashboard instead of NotFoundPage.
CRITICAL: Either add Route path='/pilot' → Pilot Portal in App.js, OR update LoginPage post-login redirect to map role 'pilot' → '/pilot-portal' (e.g., roleToPath map).

Consider a general roleToPath map in LoginPage.js (customer→/customer, operator→/operator, admin→/admin, hr→/hr, sales→/sales, finance→/finance, employee→/employee, pilot→/pilot-portal, ceo→/ceo) instead of blind `/${role}` navigation to avoid similar bugs for future roles.
Remove/gate the seeded 'CRITICAL Risk Login Detected-hacker@test.com' emergency event from admin dashboard in preview/production, or make it dismissible with server-side persistence.
critical_code_review_comments: LoginPage.js lines 48-49 and 206-207: navigate(`/${role}`) assumes the frontend has a route matching every role name. This is brittle — introduce a ROLE_HOME map so post-login destination is explicit and unit-testable.
App.js: CEODashboard component exists but is orphaned (no <Route>). Dead code or missing wiring — likely regression.

success_rate.frontend: 78% (7/9 roles land on a valid dashboard; CEO and Pilot land on 404)

test_credentials: All 9 accounts in /app/memory/test_credentials.md authenticated successfully; 2FA is disabled as documented.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent adds /ceo route (wire CEODashboard) and fixes pilot redirect to /pilot-portal, re-run role login smoke: for each of the 9 roles login and assert page.url ends with the expected dashboard path AND no h1='404' is visible. Also spot-check that AdminDashboard 'CRITICAL SECURITY ALERT' banner is either removed or dismissible. Production URL https://airyatra.co.in was not tested in this iteration — main agent should confirm scope. Playwright script snippet used: fill data-testid=email-input + password-input, click submit-btn, wait for URL change from /login. Logout button selector [data-testid*='logout'] works in customer/operator/admin/employee dashboards.
rca_of_the_issue: LoginPage.js performs a naive navigate(`/${role}`) using the first role string from the auth response. This works only when the frontend Route path exactly matches the role name. It fails for two roles: (a) 'ceo' — the CEODashboard component exists at src/components/admin/CEODashboard.js but no matching <Route path='/ceo'> was added in App.js, so the URL is caught by the wildcard <Route path='*' element={<NotFoundPage/>}>. (b) 'pilot' — the pilot's actual route is /pilot-portal (defined in App.js line 281), but the login redirect goes to /pilot which also hits the wildcard NotFoundPage. Fix by introducing a ROLE_HOME_PATH map and using it in both post-login navigate() calls in LoginPage.js (lines 49 and 207), plus wiring the missing /ceo route to CEODashboard.
